items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997

ctx.x: Well you know I have to ask you about the recording you made of course. Even in the Grove Dictionary of Jazz it mentions the “Channel One Suite.” And it seems like there’s been certain times in jazz history where people have recorded things, you know Illinois Jacquet with I guess “Flyin’ Home” and Coleman Hawkins “Body and Soul,”
And this particular recording, I’m interested in. Was that the only live recording done of that particular chart first of all?
